scope.main: Theorem in sections/06a-correctness-and-completeness.tex, with assumptions in sections/04-problem-definition.tex: 13 direct core forms and 8 restricted insertion reductions. Counts use recorded normalized inputs and do not assert completeness of the executed inference path.
scope.extension: Sections 12.1--12.7 of linked proof; original nodes and holes preserved.
scope.extents: Main requires all input dimensions >=2; its insertion reductions allow supplied positive fresh extents, including one. The broader extension requires positive input and introduced extents. Original guards are unchanged and may admit zero extents.
scope.arithmetic: Exact reals and exact rational state weights; not IEEE floating point, modular integers, or general division.
scope.captures: Independent capture values, read-once per expanded component, distinct nonempty capture sets across components. No standalone constants except declared rational weights.
scope.metadata: Supplied fields, defaults and their definedness/range obligations remain fixed; no inferred extent/coordinate or hidden guard.
scope.normalization: Both directions of the legal-completion correspondence required, not merely correctness for the original handwritten attributes. Three axis cases have checked unit-only views. catalog_dot_drop_unit_dims is not added to the population.
scope.provenance: Historical A and B are separate compiler runs. A uses the broadcast-transpose companion; original frozen expression remains unresolved. Later unified regression reproduces the totals but does not replace historical results.
scope.unknown: First failures are unresolved obligations, not infeasibility certificates. Resolving them does not guarantee later proof success.
scope.restricted_insertion: One read-once component per side; source normalization merges nested insertion and moves transpose, reversal, and sums over original axes. Broadcast-created contractions use all conditions in Appendix A6. RHS has at most one outer insertion with an independent unrestricted placement. All RHS choices are preserved.

records.audit: X, Y and rank-zero C are independent captures, each used once per component. C is not assumed a fixed tensor constant. Both supplied extent lists depend only on source shapes/attributes.

The supplied inserted-extent list is empty. Convert the known source insertion to a permutation and solve the bare RHS transpose in the core. Completeness is conditional on exact reals, input extents >=2, positive inserted extents, and defined supplied metadata.

The measured source already replaces the known [N] to [1,N] view with insertion. Merge its nested insertions; N must be at least two, while the fresh leading extent may be one. Completeness is conditional on exact reals, input extents >=2, positive inserted extents, and defined supplied metadata.
Guard A == 1 establishes [1,N] -> [N]; removal axis [0] is fixed, not a new unknown. Non-unit ordered coordinates do not depend on the inferred outer injection.

For the measured companion, move source transpose through insertion. RHS extents depend only on supplied source metadata; the output placement is independently inferred. Completeness is conditional on exact reals, input extents >=2, positive inserted extents, and defined supplied metadata.
Both views are known [N] -> [1,N]. Adapter injection [1] and new_extents [1] are fixed. Only the original reversal field is inferred; all legal completions preserve the unit-only view.

The guards make the inserted left axis the sole contracting axis, with no batch axes and preserved left-free order. Normalize the LHS to outer dot of X and sum of Y over axis 0. The original RHS has independent sum and dot unknowns. Completeness is conditional on exact reals, input extents >=2, positive inserted extents, and defined supplied metadata.

Independent captures X, Y and Scale occur once in each component. Scalar Scale is a value input, not metadata weight. Supplied broadcast extents [M,N] are source sizes. The f32 task requires exact-real reinterpretation for this theorem; no IEEE claim.

The source sums only its original input axis. Move this sum below insertion; the RHS sum and insertion placement are independent unknowns. Completeness is conditional on exact reals, input extents >=2, positive inserted extents, and defined supplied metadata.
